ex.en: This phone case is known for its durability.
ex.zh: 這款手機殼以耐用著稱。

ex.en: We tested the durability of the material.
ex.zh: 我們測試了這種材料的耐用度。

durability.en: the ability to last a long time without breaking

ex.en: Please stay seated for the duration of the flight.
ex.zh: 飛行全程請留在座位上。

ex.en: The duration of the contract is two years.
ex.zh: 合約期限為兩年。

duration.en: the length of time that something continues

ex.en: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
ex.zh: 咖啡讓我在無聊的音樂會上保持清醒。

ex.en: I used to feel it dull.
ex.zh: 我以前覺得這很無聊。

ex.en: The meeting was long and dull.
ex.zh: 這場會議又長又無聊。

ex.en: The point of the pencil has become dull.
ex.zh: 鉛筆的筆尖鈍了。

ex.en: My knife has become dull.
ex.zh: 我的刀變鈍了。

ex.en: It was a dull, gray morning.
ex.zh: 那是個陰沉灰暗的早晨。

ex.en: The paint looks dull after many years.
ex.zh: 油漆過了很多年看起來很暗淡。

ex.en: Someone dumped trash by the river.
ex.zh: 有人把垃圾丟在河邊。

ex.en: Don't just dump your bags on the floor.
ex.zh: 別把包包隨便丟在地上。

dump.en: to throw something away in a careless way

ex.en: We all wondered why she had dumped such a nice man.
ex.zh: 我們都不懂她為什麼要甩掉那麼好的男人。

ex.en: My girlfriend dumped me.
ex.zh: 我女朋友甩了我。

ex.en: Is Tom going to dump Mary?
ex.zh: 湯姆要跟瑪麗分手嗎？

dump.en: to end a romantic relationship with someone

ex.en: The company was accused of dumping cheap steel overseas.
ex.zh: 這家公司被指控在海外傾銷廉價鋼鐵。

ex.en: Dumping goods below cost is illegal.
ex.zh: 以低於成本的價格傾銷商品是違法的。

dump.en: to sell goods in another country at a very low price

ex.en: We took the old sofa to the dump.
ex.zh: 我們把舊沙發載到垃圾場。

ex.en: This room is a dump!
ex.zh: 這房間簡直像垃圾堆！

dump.en: a place where rubbish is left, or a dirty, untidy place

ex.en: Microsoft recently unveiled two new dual screen devices.
ex.zh: 微軟最近推出了兩款新的雙螢幕裝置。

ex.en: She has dual citizenship.
ex.zh: 她有雙重國籍。

ex.en: This room serves a dual purpose as an office and a guest room.
ex.zh: 這個房間兼具辦公室和客房兩種用途。

dual.en: having two parts or two uses

ex.en: The contract was duly signed by both parties.
ex.zh: 合約已由雙方正式簽署。

ex.en: Your application has been duly received.
ex.zh: 您的申請已妥善收到。

duly.en: in the correct or proper way

ex.en: The package duly arrived on Monday.
ex.zh: 包裹如期在星期一送達。

ex.en: She promised to call, and she duly did.
ex.zh: 她答應會打電話，後來果然打了。

duly.en: as expected, at the right time

ex.en: The movie was dubbed into Mandarin.
ex.zh: 這部電影被配成了國語。

ex.en: Do you prefer dubbed or subtitled films?
ex.zh: 你比較喜歡配音版還是字幕版的電影？

dub.en: to change the spoken language of a film into another language

ex.en: There are so many mistakes in this book that the teacher has dubbed it "The Drunkard's Edition".
ex.zh: 這本書錯誤多到老師稱它為「醉鬼版」。

ex.en: The press dubbed him "the king of startups."
ex.zh: 媒體封他為「新創之王」。

dub.en: to give someone or something a name or nickname

ex.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
ex.zh: 公司因缺乏資金而倒閉。

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

ex.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣變差，出發延後了。

ex.en: The rent is due on the first of the month.
ex.zh: 房租每月一號到期。

ex.en: When is the report due?
ex.zh: 報告什麼時候要交？

due.en: needing to be paid or done by a certain time

ex.en: The train is due to arrive at 3 p.m.
ex.zh: 火車預定下午三點抵達。

ex.en: Her baby is due in May.
ex.zh: 她的預產期在五月。

due.en: expected to happen or arrive at a certain time

ex.en: Cross off the names of the people who have paid their dues.
ex.zh: 請把已經繳費的人名字劃掉。

ex.en: Members pay their dues every year.
ex.zh: 會員每年繳會費。

due.en: money that you pay to belong to a club or group

ex.en: It is the students' duty to clean their classrooms.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是學生的責任。

ex.en: I believe it my duty to protect these children.
ex.zh: 我認為保護這些孩子是我的責任。

duty.en: something that you must do because it is right or the law

ex.en: She performed her duties.
ex.zh: 她盡了自己的職責。

ex.en: My duties include answering phones and scheduling meetings.
ex.zh: 我的職務包括接電話和安排會議。

duty.en: a task that is part of your job

ex.en: You have to pay duty on imported goods.
ex.zh: 進口商品必須繳關稅。

ex.en: Import duties on cars are very high here.
ex.zh: 這裡汽車的進口關稅很高。

duty.en: a tax that you pay on goods, especially from other countries

duty.zh: on duty / off duty：值班中／下班、不值班

ex.en: Which doctor is on duty tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚是哪位醫生值班？

ex.en: The security guard is off duty now.
ex.zh: 那位警衛現在已經下班了。

duty.en: working, or not working, at a certain time

ex.en: All the furniture was covered with dust.
ex.zh: 所有家具都積滿了灰塵。

ex.en: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
ex.zh: 你可能對花粉或灰塵過敏。

ex.en: Dust got into one of my eyes.
ex.zh: 灰塵跑進了我的一隻眼睛。

dust.en: very small dry pieces of dirt that lie on surfaces

ex.en: She dusts the furniture every day.
ex.zh: 她每天擦家具上的灰塵。

ex.en: Please dust the shelves before the guests arrive.
ex.zh: 客人來之前請把架子上的灰塵擦乾淨。

dust.en: to wipe fine powdery dirt off furniture or other surfaces

ex.en: That's a dumb question.
ex.zh: 這是一個愚蠢的問題。

ex.en: I think you're dumb.
ex.zh: 我認為你傻。

ex.en: The world is full of dumb people.
ex.zh: 世界上都是白痴。

ex.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and dumb.
ex.zh: 海倫凱勒眼盲，耳聾，又啞。

ex.en: She was blind, deaf, and dumb.
ex.zh: 她又盲又聾又啞。

dumb.en: not able to speak (can be offensive)

ex.en: Tom got a computer virus while he was watching videos on dubious Internet sites.
ex.zh: 湯姆在可疑的網站上看影片的時候中了電腦病毒。

ex.en: He made a dubious claim that nobody could verify.
ex.zh: 他提出了一個沒人能證實的可疑說法。

dubious.en: not completely honest or good, or not to be trusted

ex.en: The duke lived in a huge castle with his family.
ex.zh: 公爵和家人住在一座巨大的城堡裡。

ex.en: The young duke inherited his title when his father died.
ex.zh: 年輕的公爵在父親過世後繼承了爵位。

duke.en: a man of very high rank in a noble family

ex.en: As a dutiful son, he visits his parents every weekend.
ex.zh: 身為孝順的兒子，他每個週末都回去看父母。

ex.en: She was a dutiful employee who never missed a deadline.
ex.zh: 她是個盡責的員工，從不錯過任何期限。

dutiful.en: doing what you should do and respecting others

ex.en: This contract is made in duplicate.
ex.zh: 本合約一式兩份。

ex.en: I lost my key, so I had a duplicate made.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了鑰匙，所以去打了一把備份。

ex.en: Don't duplicate work that someone else has already done.
ex.zh: 別重複做別人已經做過的工作。

ex.en: The results could not be duplicated.
ex.zh: 這些結果無法再次重現。

duplicate.en: to make an exact copy of something, or to do something again

ex.en: These boots are durable and waterproof.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子耐穿又防水。

ex.en: We need a durable material for the outdoor tables.
ex.zh: 戶外桌子需要用耐用的材質。

durable.en: strong and able to last a long time

ex.en: The buyer completed due diligence before signing.
ex.zh: 買方在簽約前完成了盡職調查。

ex.en: Our legal team is conducting due diligence on the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們的法務團隊正在對供應商進行盡職調查。

due diligence.en: a careful check of facts and risks before making a deal

ex.en: The inquiry examined allegations of steel dumping.
ex.zh: 這項調查檢視了鋼材傾銷的指控。

ex.en: Import duties were imposed to prevent dumping.
ex.zh: 政府課徵進口關稅以防止傾銷。

dumping.en: the selling of goods abroad at a very low price

ex.en: They bought a duplex and rented out the other unit.
ex.zh: 他們買了一棟雙拼住宅，並把另一戶出租。

ex.en: The duplex has separate entrances for both families.
ex.zh: 這棟複式住宅有兩個獨立出入口，供兩戶家庭使用。

duplex.en: a house divided into two homes, or a home on two floors

ex.en: Is this a duty-free shop?
ex.zh: 這是免稅店嗎？

ex.en: I bought some duty-free chocolate at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場買了一些免稅巧克力。

ex.en: We fed bread to the ducks at the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖邊拿麵包餵鴨子。

ex.en: A mother duck led her babies across the path.
ex.zh: 鴨媽媽帶著小鴨走過小路。

ex.en: He ducked just in time to avoid the ball.
ex.zh: 他及時低頭閃過了那顆球。

ex.en: You have to duck when you walk through this low door.
ex.zh: 走過這道低矮的門時你得低下頭。

ex.en: The mayor ducked the reporter's difficult question.
ex.zh: 市長閃避了記者的刁鑽問題。

ex.en: He ducked out of the meeting early.
ex.zh: 他提早從會議中溜走了。

ex.en: I fell asleep during the movie.
ex.zh: 我看電影時睡著了。

ex.en: We visited many museums during our trip to Europe.
ex.zh: 我們歐洲之行期間參觀了很多博物館。

ex.en: Please keep quiet during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試期間請保持安靜。

durham.zh: 達勒姆（英格蘭的郡與城市）

ex.en: Durham is a county in the northeast of England.
ex.zh: 達勒姆是英格蘭東北部的一個郡。

ex.en: The city of Durham is famous for its old cathedral.
ex.zh: 達勒姆市以古老的大教堂聞名。

ex.en: She is learning Dutch because she plans to live in Amsterdam.
ex.zh: 她打算住在阿姆斯特丹，所以正在學荷蘭語。

ex.en: The Dutch are known for riding bicycles everywhere.
ex.zh: 荷蘭人以到處騎腳踏車聞名。

ex.en: We bought some Dutch cheese at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些荷蘭起司。

ex.en: The museum has many famous Dutch paintings.
ex.zh: 這間博物館有許多著名的荷蘭畫作。

ex.en: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.
ex.zh: 都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都。

ex.en: We walked along the river in Dublin after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們沿著都柏林的河邊散步。

ex.en: Duncan is a name that comes from Scotland.
ex.zh: 鄧肯這個名字源自蘇格蘭。

ex.en: Duncan is both a surname and a first name.
ex.zh: 鄧肯既是姓氏，也可以當作名字。

ex.en: The old books on the shelf were covered with dust and looked dusty.
ex.zh: 架上的舊書蒙著一層灰，看起來髒兮兮的。

ex.en: We walked along a dusty road in the summer heat.
ex.zh: 我們在夏日的熱氣中走在一條塵土飛揚的路上。

ex.en: The attic was dark, dusty, and full of old boxes.
ex.zh: 閣樓又暗又滿是灰塵，堆滿了舊箱子。

ex.en: Dundee is a port city on the east coast of Scotland.
ex.zh: 敦提是蘇格蘭東海岸的一座港市。

ex.en: We took a train from Edinburgh to Dundee.
ex.zh: 我們搭火車從愛丁堡到敦提。

ex.en: The duchess greeted the guests at the entrance of the castle.
ex.zh: 公爵夫人在城堡入口迎接賓客。

ex.en: In the novel, the duchess is kind to everyone in her village.
ex.zh: 小說裡的公爵夫人對村裡每個人都很和善。

ex.en: The children slid down the sand dune on a plastic board.
ex.zh: 孩子們坐在塑膠板上從沙丘滑下來。

ex.en: The wind slowly moves the dunes across the desert.
ex.zh: 風慢慢地讓沙丘在沙漠中移動。

ex.en: The streetlights come on at dusk.
ex.zh: 路燈在黃昏時亮起。

ex.en: We walked home along the river at dusk.
ex.zh: 黃昏時我們沿著河邊走路回家。

ex.en: The doctor found a duodenal ulcer.
ex.zh: 醫生發現了十二指腸潰瘍。

ex.en: Duodenal problems can cause pain after meals.
ex.zh: 十二指腸的問題可能在飯後造成疼痛。

ex.en: The small duchy was ruled by a duke for centuries.
ex.zh: 這個小公國數百年來由一位公爵統治。

ex.en: The castle once belonged to the duchy of Burgundy.
ex.zh: 這座城堡曾屬於勃艮第公國。

ex.en: Hey dude, are you coming to the game tonight?
ex.zh: 嘿老兄，你今晚要來看比賽嗎？

ex.en: That dude over there is my cousin.
ex.zh: 那邊那個傢伙是我表哥。

dude.zh: 天啊；老兄（表示驚訝或不滿）

ex.en: Dude, that was an amazing goal!
ex.zh: 天啊，那個進球太神了！

ex.en: Dude, you forgot my birthday again.
ex.zh: 老兄，你又忘了我的生日。

ex.en: Warm air flows through the duct into every room.
ex.zh: 暖氣經由管道流進每個房間。

ex.en: A mouse got stuck in the air duct.
ex.zh: 一隻老鼠卡在通風管裡。

ex.en: Tears flow through the tear duct.
ex.zh: 眼淚經由淚管流出。

ex.en: The comedy duo made the whole audience laugh.
ex.zh: 這對搞笑搭檔把全場觀眾都逗笑了。

ex.en: The singing duo performed two songs at the wedding.
ex.zh: 這個二重唱組合在婚禮上演唱了兩首歌。

ex.en: Please put the empty bottles in the dustbin.
ex.zh: 請把空瓶子丟進垃圾桶。

ex.en: The dustbin outside is full and needs to be emptied.
ex.zh: 外面的垃圾桶滿了，需要清空。

ex.en: The shop window displayed a dummy wearing a winter coat.
ex.zh: 櫥窗裡展示著一個穿著冬季大衣的人體模型。

ex.en: Crash test dummies help engineers study car safety.
ex.zh: 撞擊測試假人幫助工程師研究汽車安全。

ex.en: Don't be a dummy; read the instructions first.
ex.zh: 別犯傻了，先看說明書。

ex.en: I felt like a dummy when I forgot my own address.
ex.zh: 我連自己的地址都忘了，覺得自己像個笨蛋。

ex.en: The guard held a dummy gun during the drill.
ex.zh: 演習時警衛拿的是一把假槍。

ex.en: They placed a dummy package in the car as a decoy.
ex.zh: 他們在車裡放了一個假包裹當誘餌。

ex.en: Members must pay their annual dues by January.
ex.zh: 會員必須在一月前繳交年度會費。

ex.en: The club raised its dues this year.
ex.zh: 俱樂部今年調漲了會費。

ex.en: The villagers crossed the river in a dugout made from a single log.
ex.zh: 村民們乘著一根原木鑿成的獨木舟渡河。

ex.en: The museum has an old dugout found at the bottom of a lake.
ex.zh: 博物館裡有一艘在湖底發現的古老獨木舟。

ex.en: The players waited in the dugout for the next inning.
ex.zh: 球員們在休息區裡等著下一局。

ex.en: The manager walked out of the dugout to speak with the umpire.
ex.zh: 教練走出休息區去和裁判說話。

ex.en: Duplication of work wastes time and money.
ex.zh: 重複的工作浪費時間和金錢。

ex.en: The duplication of files can take a long time.
ex.zh: 複製檔案可能要花很長的時間。

ex.en: The two sisters sang a beautiful duet at the concert.
ex.zh: 兩姊妹在音樂會上合唱了一首動聽的二重唱。

ex.en: They played a piano duet for their parents.
ex.zh: 他們為父母彈奏了一首鋼琴四手聯彈。

ex.en: He lifts a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the gym.
ex.zh: 他在健身房兩手各舉著一個重啞鈴。

ex.en: I keep a pair of dumbbells under my bed for home workouts.
ex.zh: 我在床底下放了一對啞鈴，在家運動用。

ex.en: Start with a light dumbbell and increase the weight slowly.
ex.zh: 先從輕的啞鈴開始，再慢慢增加重量。

ex.en: I pulled the duvet over my head and went back to sleep.
ex.zh: 我把被子拉到頭上又繼續睡。

ex.en: This duvet is warm enough for the winter.
ex.zh: 這條被子在冬天夠暖和。

ex.en: The two men fought a duel with swords in the old story.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，兩個男人用劍進行決鬥。

ex.en: The final match turned into a duel between the top two players.
ex.zh: 決賽成了兩位頂尖選手之間的對決。

ex.en: The knights agreed to duel at dawn.
ex.zh: 騎士們同意在黎明決鬥。

ex.en: In the film, the two rivals duel on a bridge.
ex.zh: 在電影中，兩名對手在橋上決鬥。

ex.en: We made pork dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 除夕夜我們一起包豬肉餃子。

ex.en: She ordered a plate of steamed dumplings.
ex.zh: 她點了一盤蒸餃。

ex.en: Grandma added dumplings to the hot chicken soup.
ex.zh: 奶奶在熱雞湯裡加了麵糰子。

ex.en: Sweet dumplings in ginger soup are a winter treat.
ex.zh: 薑湯裡的甜湯圓是冬天的點心。

ex.en: He dutifully called his mother every Sunday.
ex.zh: 他每個星期天都盡責地打電話給媽媽。

ex.en: The children dutifully lined up at the door.
ex.zh: 孩子們乖乖地在門口排好隊。

durkheim.zh: 涂爾幹（法國社會學家姓氏）

ex.en: Durkheim was a French sociologist who studied how societies stay together.
ex.zh: 涂爾幹是研究社會如何凝聚在一起的法國社會學家。

ex.en: In sociology class we discussed a famous study by Durkheim.
ex.zh: 在社會學課上我們討論了涂爾幹的一項著名研究。

ex.en: We made pork dumplings together for the holiday.
ex.zh: 我們一起為節日包了豬肉餃子。

ex.en: He dipped the dumpling in soy sauce.
ex.zh: 他把餃子沾了醬油。

ex.en: He likes to dunk his biscuit in tea.
ex.zh: 他喜歡把餅乾浸在茶裡。

ex.en: The kids dunk apples in caramel at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子們在派對上把蘋果沾焦糖。

ex.en: The tall player can dunk with one hand.
ex.zh: 那位高個子球員可以單手灌籃。

ex.en: He jumped high and dunked the ball.
ex.zh: 他高高躍起，把球灌進籃框。

ex.en: Farmers use cow dung to fertilize the fields.
ex.zh: 農夫用牛糞替田地施肥。

ex.en: Dung beetles roll the dung into balls.
ex.zh: 蜣螂會把糞便滾成球。

ex.en: He threw his gym clothes into a duffel and left.
ex.zh: 他把運動服丟進圓筒旅行袋就出門了。

ex.en: She carried a heavy duffel bag onto the train.
ex.zh: 她拎著一個沉重的大旅行袋上了火車。

ex.en: The workers threw the old furniture into a dumpster.
ex.zh: 工人把舊家具丟進大型垃圾箱。

ex.en: A dumpster sat in the driveway during the renovation.
ex.zh: 整修期間，車道上放著一個大型垃圾箱。

dunkirk.zh: 敦刻爾克（法國北部港市）

ex.en: Dunkirk is a port city in northern France.
ex.zh: 敦刻爾克是法國北部的一座港口城市。

ex.en: Many ferries cross the sea from Dunkirk to England.
ex.zh: 許多渡輪從敦刻爾克橫渡海峽前往英國。

ex.en: The prisoners were kept in a dark dungeon beneath the castle.
ex.zh: 囚犯被關在城堡底下陰暗的地牢裡。

ex.en: In the game, you must escape from the dungeon.
ex.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，你必須逃出地牢。

ex.en: The film explores the duality of good and evil.
ex.zh: 這部電影探討善與惡的二元性。

ex.en: There is a duality in his character: he is both shy and bold.
ex.zh: 他的性格有雙重性：既害羞又大膽。

ex.en: The salesman tried to dupe old people into buying useless goods.
ex.zh: 那名業務員想騙老人買沒用的商品。

ex.en: Don't let anyone dupe you into giving away your password.
ex.zh: 別讓任何人騙你交出密碼。

ex.en: He realized he had been a dupe in their clever plan.
ex.zh: 他發現自己在他們的精心計畫裡成了被騙的人。

ex.en: The criminals used a dupe to carry the package across the border.
ex.zh: 罪犯利用一個不知情的人把包裹帶過邊境。

dumfries.zh: 敦夫里斯（蘇格蘭南部城鎮）

ex.en: Dumfries is a town in the south of Scotland.
ex.zh: 敦夫里斯是蘇格蘭南部的一座城鎮。

ex.en: We drove through Dumfries on our way to the coast.
ex.zh: 我們前往海岸的途中經過了敦夫里斯。

ex.en: The battery turned out to be a dud and died in minutes.
ex.zh: 那顆電池根本是廢物，幾分鐘就沒電了。

ex.en: The bomb was a dud and never exploded.
ex.zh: 那顆炸彈是啞彈，一直沒有爆炸。

ex.en: I bought a dud phone that never worked properly.
ex.zh: 我買到一支有瑕疵的手機，從來沒正常運作過。

ex.en: They threw away the dud batteries.
ex.zh: 他們把壞掉的電池丟掉了。

ex.en: He signed the paper under duress.
ex.zh: 他是在脅迫下簽了那份文件。

ex.en: A promise made under duress may not be legal.
ex.zh: 在脅迫之下做出的承諾可能不具法律效力。

ex.en: The family lived in a large ducal palace.
ex.zh: 這個家族住在一座大型公爵宮殿裡。

ex.en: He inherited the ducal title from his father.
ex.zh: 他從父親那裡繼承了公爵的頭銜。

ex.en: We walked home in the dusky evening light.
ex.zh: 我們在昏暗的暮色中走路回家。

ex.en: She has a dusky blue scarf.
ex.zh: 她有一條暗藍色的圍巾。

ex.en: She used a feather duster to clean the shelves.
ex.zh: 她用雞毛撣子清掃書架。

ex.en: The cleaner hung the duster by the door.
ex.zh: 清潔人員把撣子掛在門邊。

ex.en: The cowboy wore a long duster against the dust.
ex.zh: 牛仔穿著長版風衣防塵。

ex.en: She slipped a light duster over her dress.
ex.zh: 她在洋裝外面披上一件輕薄的長外套。

ex.en: The philosopher wrote about the dualism of mind and body.
ex.zh: 這位哲學家寫過關於身心二元論的文章。

ex.en: The story shows a dualism between good and evil.
ex.zh: 這個故事呈現出善與惡的二元對立。

ex.en: His sudden announcement did dumbfound the whole family.
ex.zh: 他突然的宣布讓全家人都驚呆了。

ex.en: The magician's last trick is sure to dumbfound the audience.
ex.zh: 魔術師的最後一個把戲一定會讓觀眾目瞪口呆。

ex.en: The Dutchman cycled to work every morning.
ex.zh: 那位荷蘭男子每天早上騎自行車上班。

ex.en: A Dutchman won the race.
ex.zh: 一位荷蘭選手贏得了比賽。

ex.en: Her duplicity was exposed when the two stories didn't match.
ex.zh: 兩個說法對不上時，她的表裡不一就被揭穿了。

ex.en: He was shocked by the duplicity of his closest friend.
ex.zh: 他對摯友的口是心非感到震驚。

ex.en: A line of ducklings followed their mother across the road.
ex.zh: 一排小鴨跟著鴨媽媽過馬路。

ex.en: The duckling swam happily in the little pond.
ex.zh: 小鴨在小池塘裡開心地游著。
